description.narrative: The Project has an AIMM rating of Good, based on an AIMM score of 55. On an unadjusted basis (i.e., without likelihood factor), the full potential AIMM score could reach 70. The main Project outcomes are the provision of uncollateralized credit loans to micro and small enterprises with limited access to finance, and the growth of lending to women entrepreneurs. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the Project will help foster competitiveness in the MSME finance market by demonstrating the scalability of a technology-led business model to sustainably provide finance for MSMEs.

The proposed project is an up to US$20 million (equivalent in South Africa Rand (ZAR)) senior unsecured loan under the MSME Finance Platform - BOP Envelope with a 4-year (2-year grace) tenor to Lula Lend Pty Ltd (Lulalend or the Company), an existing equity client of IFC. The loan is comprised of a US$10 million A Loan for IFCs own account and an up to US$10 million B Loan. The proceeds of the IFC loan will support the expansion of the Companys loan portfolio to Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs), including [25%] for Women-owned MSMEs (WMSMEs), in South Africa (the Project). To meet the MSME Finance Platforms eligibility criteria for use of proceeds under the BOP Envelope, sub-projects should seek to address financial inclusion gaps with a focus on micro and small enterprises (MSEs), informal enterprises, and low-income households with an average aggregate outstanding loan size not to exceed US$100 thousand.
